_comment: Batch 01 of reference generations for tools/meshy_import.py - image-to-3D from curated
List without spending:  python tools/meshy_import.py --batch resources/reference/meshy/batch_01.json --dry-run
Every entry is ONE paid generation (image-to-3D, textured, ai_model latest = 30 credits).
SIZES: read each entry's size_basis. 'SOURCED' = a page-read dimension of that building from the
era dossier (docs/evidence/worldforge_v2/era_reference/<era>.md, row id given). 'NOMINAL' = no
sourced overall dimension for that building: the value is a type figure or a placeholder, good for
proportions only, and must never be typed into engine data as a dimension.
All entries are kind 'building' (reference stamps, do-not-place), including four pieces of street
furniture (well-head, market cross, street fountain, torii).
